title: AI Taking Over Junior Dev Jobs?
full_monologue: **AI agents are replacing junior developers**. It's happening faster than you think. These tools can write code, debug issues, and even understand complex requirements—without the need for years of experience. But does this mean the end for new devs? Not necessarily. It’s shifting the focus from basic tasks to higher-level problem-solving. The future belongs to those who adapt. So, what skills will junior devs need to stay relevant? Let me know in the comments.
